reviews.summary: The change adds section maps, section headers, and function/method docstrings to aios/forge.py, gate.py, and land.py, and replaces BUG-14 mentions in forge.py and tests/test_forge.py with plain prose. The unittest suite and compileall pass, but the code-identity acceptance criterion was not exercised and the forge.py BUG-14 edit can potentially count as a code layout change, so the diff cannot be merged as-is.

Adds a numbered section map to the module docstrings of gate.py, land.py and forge.py, and a `# --- N. name ---` header with `# From:` and `# To:` lines before each section. It also adds one-line docstrings to the functions and methods the diff shows as lacking one. The single BUG-14 inline comment in forge.py becomes a plain-words comment on its own line, and the three BUG-14 mentions in tests/test_forge.py (one docstring, two trailing comments) get plain wording. Every change is a comment or docstring, so the code AST should be unchanged. The AST checker itself was not shown running, but the unit tests (322 run, 2 skipped, exit 0) and compileall pass. The new descriptions match the code visible in the diff, for example Local.land returning the merge sha and the close/reopen nudge. Only files in files_allowed were touched. I could not see whether any function the diff does not show already had a docstring, so I did not block on that.
